WAF, Shield, and Firewall Manager: what are the differences?

WAF filters layer 7 HTTP/HTTPS requests with a Web ACL (SQLi, XSS, bots, rate-based, geo). Shield protects against DDoS: Standard is free on layers 3/4, Advanced is paid and adds a 24/7 response team, bill protection, and automatic L7 mitigation. Firewall Manager deploys and manages these protections centrally across all the accounts of an Organization.
How do you build a DDoS defense on AWS?

You put CloudFront (or Global Accelerator) and Route 53 on the front line, add WAF with rate-based rules and managed rules, hide the backend behind CloudFront, API Gateway, or an ELB, filter with Security Groups and NACLs, and plan ELB and Auto Scaling to absorb the load. Shield Advanced completes this with dedicated support and automatic L7 mitigation.
